d: Jet black hair is styled in a short, shoulder-length bob with straight-cut bangs and a side-swept parting. Large, expressive eyes are a warm amber-brown shade, set in a youthful face with an adolescent maturity. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a dark navy blue sleeveless dress over a white short-sleeved blouse, complemented by a black belt at the waist. Signature details include a small white hair clip and several large, grey metallic naval gun turrets attached to the outfit and floating around the body.
